description: The newsletter's call to action must be a single fully qualified URL with all three UTM parameters, and never a link shortener, closing with the roof line.

proof_points: live Fabric implementations already in production
a Synapse to Fabric migration with zero broken dashboards

rubric.criterion: CTA URL is fully qualified with UTM parameters
rubric.condition: The newsletter body contains exactly one URL starting with https://www.canvasintelligence.com/ carrying utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign.
The last non-empty line of the newsletter body is exactly the string: Your Data. Delivered.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rules 3 and 4.
